your video in half. `ac

## v1.1 · subtitle act (2026-11-01)

`GET /av-sync/api?act=subtitle&text=...&dur=8.8` — splits segment text into
phrases (punctuation sta

ys at the tail of the previous phrase), schedules each
by character-weight proportion across the voi

ceover window. Powers on-screen
subtitles that switch exactly when the voice says the next phrase.
## Layer rule

Portrait first, text last — text always renders above the character art;
character art ≤50% of frame
height, proportional scaling only.
